subject: Vendor onboarding: purchase token gap analysis & SKU breakdown needed
messages:
From: Maya Rios <maya.rios@helio-tech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: contracts@helio-tech.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding pack + PO issuance question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding checklist this morning. As we try to align internal procurement timelines, two items are blocking our finance team from issuing the formal purchase order:

1) Purchase token / PO number: your onboarding portal returned a provisional purchase token but our AP needs the final PO number to link invoices.
2) Spend cap & line items: the SKU list we submitted is aggregated (one line, multiple SKUs). Our controller is asking for explicit line-item pricing or a spend-band cap per SKU so they can route approvals.

Attached: onboarding form (helio_onboarding_form.pdf) and the initial SKU workbook (initial_sku_list.xlsx). Can you advise what data you need from us to get a definitive PO number and whether Redwood can issue provisional PO numbers in the interim?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our quarter close is next week.

Best,
Maya Rios
Head of Partnerships
HelioTech

---
Attachment stubs: helio_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), initial_sku_list.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maya Rios <maya.rios@helio-tech.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding pack + PO issuance question

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for the attachments. Putting procurement and onboarding steps in one place so we can move fast: 

Summary of what we need to issue a permanent PO number:
- SKU-level breakout with unit price or a mapped spend bucket per SKU (your initial workbook is a helpful start but the AP team needs separate rows per SKU).
- Billing/legal contact for invoicing (we saw contracts@helio-tech.com on cc — if that’s the right inbox we’ll include them on the DocuSign and invoice routing).
- Confirmation of desired spend cap behavior: fixed monthly cap vs. cumulative project cap.

Interim option: Redwood can provisionally reserve a PO token (prov-PO-####) so your AP can transmit invoices while we finalize the permanent PO number. That provisional token does not guarantee spend beyond the agreed cap — we’ll convert once the SKU mapping arrives.

Action items (proposed timeline):
- Today (by EOD): Helio provides SKU breakout as CSV with unit price or spend band per SKU.
- Tomorrow morning: Procurement (Priyom) will validate mapping and return the PO number or request one final clarification.

I’ve attached a lightweight CSV template we prefer for mapping (ponum_mapping.csv) — fill column A with SKU, column B with unit price or band, column C with desired spend cap code.

If that works I’ll ask Priyom to take point on the ledger mapping and final PO issuance.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stub: ponum_mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>, Maya Rios <maya.rios@helio-tech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding pack + PO issuance question

Thanks — looping in procurement details so Helio has full visibility. Quick notes from our side: 

- Ledger mapping: we require a ledger code per line item. If Helio sends the SKU breakout with suggested unit prices we’ll map to our GL and confirm the PO number.
- Spend caps: recommend using a cumulative project cap for first 90 days (gives both orgs headroom while usage stabilizes). If Helio prefers monthly caps that’s fine — just call it out in column C of the CSV.
- Line-item corrections: I noticed two SKUs in the workbook appear to be bundled (SKU HLT-CORE-23 + HLT-AI-EXT). Break them out into separate rows otherwise our PO will create an aggregate description that causes your AP to reject invoices.

If you can upload the filled ponum_mapping.csv to the Drive link Sofia shared, I’ll validate and issue a permanent PO number (PO-2026-6789-HT) or come back with a specific correction request within 4 business hours.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
